notes.title: Retro Inventory Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]Retro Inventory[/h1]

We've now added a Retro-styled Inventory!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28406341/adf5c9fba82492269727cb39f1db70e8617e0970.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28406341/0c0254922d9517e9b62f6cf4df330924d7881cfd.png[/img]

You can enable it under Options>Retro. We didn't enable it by default as the Retro Inventory only supports English at the moment. Let us know what you think!

[h1]Language mods[/h1]

We have made some internal change to the engine to make it easier for people to provide and maintain language mods. Some third-party mods have been in the work for Russian, Chinese Simplified, etc. Check out for the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/543260/discussions/2/]modding/hacking discussion forum[/url] where current and future creator may post them!

Traply yours,
The Lizardcube and DotEmu teams.

notes.title: Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap will release on PC this week
notes.notes:
Wonder Boy: The Dragon's Trap originally released in 1989 as a Sega Master System exclusive, and in my opinion, it was among the best titles for that console. Earlier this year a remake launched for the Nintendo Switch, and it's probably among the prettiest remakes of an 8-bit platformer ever made, but crucially, the remake can also be played with its original pixel-style graphics.

The game launches June 9 on Steam and GOG, and while there are more fun and complex platformer adventures available in this day and age, anyone with a lingering nostalgia for old classics will likely enjoy The Dragon's Trap. In a neat twist, you can switch between the modern graphics and the 8-bit graphics mid-game.
